b: , indecl., fifteenth (later fourteenth) letter of most of the Eastern Greek alphabets, including the Ionic (later general Gr.) alphabet; not used in Western Greek alphabets or in the native Attic alphabet; in form and serial position (IG 14.2420) it corresponds to the Semitic
samech (a form of s), but has acquired the new value ks; as numeral
bounteous giver, epith. of Apollo, AP 9.525.15.
